verdict.rationale: The evidence describes Smithery's REST interface, typed SDKs, and a CLI that uses structured commands such as `smithery mcp search [term]` and `smithery tool call <connection> <tool> [args]`. Nothing shows a natural-language interface for operating Smithery itself. Agents can call MCP tools through the platform, but that is a building block for other agents, not natural-language control of the product. The hosted services were also shut down on 2026-10-31.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
